Perfect! All 60 tests pass. I added `renderInvoiceText(invoice)` in src/render.js with 9 new tests.

**renderInvoiceText** — Renders an invoice as plain text with:
- First line: invoice number (or DRAFT if unsent)
- Second line: customer name (looked up from customerId)
- One line per invoice line: qty × product name @ unit price = line total
- Last line: Total: <formatted total>

All amounts are formatted using `formatEuros()` from src/money.js, so customers see proper euro formatting with thousands separators and two decimals.

Example output:
```
INV-2026-0001
Northwind Studio
10 × Design work (hour) @ €85.00 = €850.00
Total: €850.00
```
